data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Monday, August 24, 2026: Prices rising, as investors look for more Fed clues this week
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $77,727.62 on Monday, August 24, 2026, 0.8% higher than Sunday's opening price. As of 8:50 a.m. ET, bitcoin rose to $79,106.77. Ethereum opened at $2,463.09 today, up 1.6% from Sunday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved to $2,507.22 as of 8:53 a.m. ET.
